headline: Danantara Targets 100 World-Class SOEs by 2030, IPO as Strategy
summary: Indonesia's Danantara and the SOE ministry plan to transform 100 state-owned companies into world-class firms by 2030. The strategy focuses on restructuring and human resources, with IPOs part of the approach.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund that holds and manages state-owned enterprises. Its restructuring and listing plans affect investors in Indonesian state companies.
original_headline: Danantara Bidik 100 BUMN Berkelas Dunia pada 2030, IPO Jadi Strategi
